content_sections.heading: How to Attend HBCH&RC One Year Fellow Walk-in Interview
content_sections.text: Prepare your resume and gather all required educational, experience, and category certificates along with two recent passport-size photographs. Ensure you fulfill the eligibility criteria and carry both photocopies and original documents for verification at the venue. Persons working under Central/State Government, Autonomous Bodies, Semi-Government Organizations, or Public Sector Undertakings must obtain and bring permission from their Head of the Organization. Report directly to the venue between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM on 4 November 2026. Venue: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Plot No. 1, Medicity, New Chandigarh, SAS Nagar (Mohali) - Punjab - 140901.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Resume and 2 recent passport size photographs. Date of Birth Proof: Birth Certificate / School leaving Certificate / SSC passing certificate. Educational Qualification: Mark Sheet and passing certificate for all examinations. Experience Certificate: Past employment experience certificate indicating the date of joining and relieving; current employment appointment letter and last pay slip. Copy of PAN Card and Aadhar Card. Caste Certificate: Valid Caste Certificate (Government of India format), Caste Validity Certificate for ST, Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for OBC candidates. Economically Weaker Section (EWS) certificate in valid format, if applicable. Physical Disability Certificate / PwD certificate (Autism, Intellectual Disability, Specific Learning Disability & Mental illness with disability i.e. SLD), if applicable.

faq.question: Q1. What is the HBCH&RC One Year Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification published by Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre to hire 1 One Year Fellow in Interventional Radiology on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the One Year Fellow post in Interventional Radiology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 4 November 2026 between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MD in Radio-Diagnosis or an equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by MCI/NMC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for the fellowship?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is up to 40 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per Government of India instructions.
